5:813.name: FilterBar
5:813.description: Composes Tag (closeable) instances with a label and clear-all action. Use as the active-filters row above a result list.

5:826.name: CmdPalette
5:826.description: Cmd+K command palette overlay. Search + section header + result list with selected-state highlight + footer keyboard hints. Composes with Modal-style backdrop on the consumer side.

5:584.name: Breadcrumb
5:584.description: Navigation trail with / separators. Last item is the current page (full opacity), preceding items are link-style (70% opacity).

5:590.name: Tabs
5:590.description: Tab list + active panel. Active tab has bottom-border in border-focus color + small phosphor glow. Inactive tabs use muted text color.

5:764.name: Nav
5:764.description: Horizontal navigation row. Active item gets text-accent color + bottom-border indicator with amber phosphor glow.

5:791.name: Footer
5:791.description: Site footer with branding column + link columns + divider + copyright row. Use middle-dot to separate copyright fragments.

7:1015.name: LegalPage
7:1015.description: Layout primitive for Impressum / Datenschutz pages. h1 + Stand-date hero + intro + h2 sections + address block. 14px body scale codified locally (eidotters default text-sm at 20px is too big for legal-document body).

7:895.name: DosFigure
7:895.description: Demoscene-style media placeholder — title strip + framed subject + bottom-right resolution badge + caption. Use as a lead-in for blog articles or where a photograph would otherwise go.

7:933.name: ChatHistory
7:933.description: Scrollable list of ChatMessage instances showing a real conversation flow (system stamp + user/assistant turns + final streaming message).

7:949.name: ChatContainer
7:949.description: Composes ChatHistory + focused ChatInput inside a Terminal-style frame with hard amber drop shadow.

7:873.name: Brand
7:873.description: eiDotter brand mark — Logo (yolk + highlight + specular at 32×32, brand-locked amber hexes), Wordmark (text eiDotter with dimmed prefix), or BrandLockup (Logo + Wordmark side-by-side).

4:278.name: Button
4:278.description: Primary user action. 6 variants × 5 sizes × 4 states = 120. Use primary for the dominant action, secondary for less emphasis, tertiary for low-priority, destructive for irreversible operations, ghost for chrome, link for navigation embedded in text.

5:529.name: Input
5:529.description: Single-line text field with React Aria TextField under the hood. Variants cover idle / focused / error / disabled. Use for short text input — for multi-line content compose with Card body slot or build a textarea.

5:546.name: Switch
5:546.description: Boolean toggle with phosphor glow on the active state. Use for instant on/off settings. Prefer Checkbox when the change is part of a form being submitted.

5:583.name: Checkbox
5:583.description: Boolean selection using DOS bracket-text [ ] / [x] / [-]. Use in lists, settings, and forms. Indeterminate state for parent items in a tree.

5:402.name: Tag
5:402.description: Interactive label with optional close affordance and keyboard support (Delete/Backspace dismisses when closeable). 5 colors × 2 sizes × static/closeable. Compose into FilterBar for active-filter rows.

5:349.name: Badge
5:349.description: Status indicator for counts, labels, and inline status. 5 colors × 2 sizes. Non-interactive — for clickable filter chips use Tag.

5:418.name: Card
5:418.description: Content container. Default for plain surfaces, elevated for cards that should appear above the page (drop shadow), accent for cards that need an amber border emphasis.

5:695.name: Stat
5:695.description: Metric value + label + optional trend indicator. 3 sizes × with/without trend. The trend arrow uses CGA semantic colors (success green for up, error red for down).

5:504.name: Alert
5:504.description: Inline status message with optional actions and close. V.37 spec: uniform dark background, featured icon, color-tinted border. Use for in-flow status; for floating toast use Notification.

5:319.name: Icon
5:319.description: 12 public glyph names mapping to 11 unique pixelarticons + 1 custom (Close uses a custom PixelX since pixelarticons v2 has no standalone X glyph).

5:641.name: Modal
5:641.description: Overlay dialog. 3 sizes (sm 360px, md 480px, lg 640px). The backdrop is composed by the consumer — Modal renders the dialog only. Use effects/overlay token at z-index/modal.

5:712.name: Progress
5:712.description: Loading bar using DOS block characters (filled and empty) inside a bracketed track. 4 example values shipped (0/25/50/100); designers can override the fill ratio per instance.

5:763.name: Notification
5:763.description: Toast message. 5 colors × icon-with-double-rings × layered amber-glow shadow. Purely presentational — consumers handle positioning, auto-dismiss timing, and stacking.

43:125.name: Skeleton
43:125.description: DOS/CGA loading placeholder. Pending content as rows of shade characters (░ ▒ ▓) with a CRT hum-bar glow band rolling top→bottom in code (1.6s, compositor-only; gentle opacity breathing under prefers-reduced-motion). Variants: text (lines, last shortened), card (bordered surface + dense heading line), figure (contiguous dense shade field, pairs with DosFigure), timeline (marker + entry column). React props: variant, lines (per-variant defaults), animated, label (role="status"). Use Progress when completion is measurable; Skeleton for unknown-shape pending content. Since v0.27.0 (DMNC-1018).

5:613.name: Accordion
5:613.description: Collapsible section with chevron indicator. 2 variants — collapsed (chevron-down) and expanded (chevron-up + body content + divider). Compose multiple stacked accordions for FAQ-style lists.

5:790.name: Header
5:790.description: Sticky site header. Retro variant has the amber phosphor border-bottom + glow on the active nav item; modern variant uses thin gray border + subtle indicator.

5:282.name: Separator
5:282.description: Visual divider. Horizontal (1px tall, full-width) for stacked content, vertical (1px wide, full-height) for inline content.

5:654.name: InlineLink
5:654.description: In-flow navigational anchor with phosphor inversion on hover (amber background + dark text). Internal links get a triangle glyph; external links get a diagonal arrow (rendered as fallback square in Perfect DOS VGA 437 Win — designers may override).

5:667.name: InlineExpand
5:667.description: Inline disclosure widget. Collapsed shows a trigger sentence with a triangle glyph; expanded reveals content beneath with a left amber border. Use for citation-style detail in body copy — quieter than an accordion.

7:881.name: CommandPrompt
7:881.description: DOS prompt with C:\\> prefix and a blinking cursor block. Empty state shows just the prompt + cursor; typed shows the entered command.

7:1014.name: Terminal
7:1014.description: DOS window chrome — title bar with min/max/close controls + body slot. Active variant has amber title bar with dark text; inactive variant is dark with amber text.

7:919.name: ChatMessage
7:919.description: Single chat message. Role (user/assistant/system) determines the prefix glyph and color; streaming variant adds a cursor block at the message end.

7:932.name: ChatInput
7:932.description: > prompt + input field + [ SEND ] action. Variants cover empty / focused (with cursor and amber glow) / disabled.

7:894.name: TimelineNode
7:894.description: Single timeline marker. 3 shapes (circle / square / diamond) × 2 states (default amber-dim / active amber + glow). Resize per usage.
